mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.sku_id, c.quantity, c.checked, c.create_time, p.name AS productName, p.price AS productPrice, p.image AS productImage, s.specs AS specs FROM l_cart c LEFT JOIN l_product p ON c.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN l_product_sku s ON c.sku_id = s.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
